title: RE Services Personal Trading in Non-Perpetual Securities Policy (incorporating Group Policy – Personal Trading in Non-Perpetual Securities)
date_approved: 3 March 2016 (RE Services Policy; prior version 19 December 2012)

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: An employee, director (other than a non-executive director), contractor or representative of Perpetual Limited and its related bodies corporate. Subject to the Policy Principles: prohibitions on insider trading, front running, procuring/encouraging third parties to trade, conflicts of interest and high volume personal trading, when trading in Securities other than Perpetual Securities.

tiers.name: RE Services staff
tiers.description: All staff within the Responsible Entity (RE) Services business unit, which provides outsourced RE services (as Perpetual Trust Services Limited, The Trust Company (RE Services) Limited, and The Trust Company (Sydney Airports) Limited) to schemes such as the one issuing OPH's securities. In addition to the Employees' obligations, this tier must obtain pre-approval before trading in non-Perpetual securities, observe fixed non-trading periods, and maintain a personal trading register.

tiers.name: Senior Manager, Risk Manager, Corporate Client Manager, RE Services legal counsel
tiers.description: RE Services staff in these roles whose trading in non-Perpetual securities must be approved in writing by the Business Unit Head.

tiers.name: Business Unit Head
tiers.description: The RE Services Business Unit Head, whose trading in non-Perpetual securities must be approved in writing by the General Manager, Managed Fund Services.

tiers.name: Non-executive directors of Perpetual
tiers.description: Excluded from the operation of this policy generally, but the prohibition on Insider Trading still applies to them.

rules.detail: 'Securities' for the Policy Principles expressly includes 'exchange traded and OTC derivatives and contracts for difference (CFD)'. General Employees may deal in such instruments subject only to the general prohibitions (insider trading, front running, procuring third parties, conflicts of interest, high volume trading) – there is no clearance requirement for this tier.
rules.evidence: securities include all financial instruments including: ... exchange traded and OTC derivatives and contracts for difference (CFD)

rules.detail: RE Services staff must obtain written pre-approval before any trade in non-Perpetual securities, which includes OTC derivatives given the Securities definition; approval is valid for the business day granted only.
rules.evidence: Trading in non-Perpetual securities by the: Senior Manager, Risk Manager, or Corporate Client Manager, RE Services legal counsel must be approved in writing by the Business Unit Head; and Business Unit Head, must be approved in writing by the General Manager, Managed Fund Services.

rules.detail: No hedging concept, equity incentive scheme, or vesting/holding-lock terminology appears anywhere in the policy.
No mention of prepaid forwards, deferred purchase agreements or other monetisation structures.
Short selling is not named anywhere in the policy.
CFDs are expressly named within the Securities definition; general Employees may deal in them subject only to the general Policy Principles.
rules.evidence: securities include all financial instruments including: ... exchange traded and OTC derivatives and contracts for difference (CFD)

rules.detail: As a non-Perpetual security, a CFD over Securities requires the same written pre-approval as any other RE Services staff trade.
rules.evidence: Trading in non-Perpetual securities by the: Senior Manager, Risk Manager, or Corporate Client Manager, RE Services legal counsel must be approved in writing by the Business Unit Head; and Business Unit Head, must be approved in writing by the General Manager, Managed Fund Services.

rules.detail: Margin lending is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over securities is not mentioned.
No provision addresses secured or other financing arrangements in respect of securities.

A position in non-Perpetual securities acquired by RE Services staff (which would include units such as OPH's) must be held for at least three months before disposal/redemption; no exception is described.
rules.evidence: Redemptions: Position must be held for at least three months.

exemption_authority: None described. The policy contains no hardship, court-order or other exemption from its prohibitions or the three-month redemption hold; the only mechanism for otherwise-restricted trading is the section 3.2 pre-approval process, under which the Business Unit Head or General Manager, Managed Fund Services evaluates the request against the guidelines in section 3.3.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Employee includes an employee, director (other than a non-executive director), contractor or representative of Perpetual. ... RE Services provides services for the following entities: Perpetual Trust Services Limited; The Trust Company (RE Services) Limited; and The Trust Company (Sydney Airports) Limited (collectively referred to as the ‘Perpetual Entities’).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This policy regulates personal trading by staff of Perpetual's outsourced Responsible Entity business (the trustee administering the scheme behind OPH), not by OPH's own directors, the fund's investment manager, or its Compliance Committee; a funded collar offered to those actual decision-makers would not be governed by this document, so the bank should confirm whether a separate trading policy applies to them before relying on this analysis.

As an externally managed trust, OPH's own governing document set has no employee equity incentive scheme referenced here, so the unvested/vested-locked/vested-unrestricted distinction central to a funded-collar analysis over incentive equity does not arise on this document; any collar would be over units held outright.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Approval granted pursuant to this Policy is valid for that business day only. Where the RE Services staff member has failed to act on that approval, a new approval must be sought to trade on another business day.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even for the one tier that can obtain clearance (RE Services staff), any cleared leg of a collar must be executed the same business day it is approved, so multi-leg execution or a settlement delay would require fresh clearance for each leg.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Redemptions: Position must be held for at least three months.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the bank or the executive needed to redeem (rather than sell on-market) units within three months of an RE Services staff member's acquisition, that would breach this minimum holding period; collar and financing tenor for such a counterparty should exceed three months.

bespoke_clauses.clause: securities include all financial instruments including: ... exchange traded and OTC derivatives and contracts for difference (CFD)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An OTC put/call written with a bank over non-Perpetual securities (which would include OPH units) is squarely within scope of the Policy Principles for all Employees and within the pre-approval regime for RE Services staff, so its treatment does not turn on any separate 'dealing' definition.

summary: This document is Perpetual's internal 'RE Services Personal Trading in Non-Perpetual Securities Policy', governing personal trading by staff of the Perpetual entity that acts as Responsible Entity for the scheme behind OPH – it does not appear to regulate OPH's own directors, the fund's investment manager, or its Compliance Committee, so a funded collar offered to those actual decision-makers is not addressed by this document at all and a separate policy should be sought. For the population it does cover, general 'Employees' may deal in Securities (expressly including OTC derivatives and CFDs) subject only to insider trading, front-running, conflicts-of-interest and high-volume-trading principles, with no clearance requirement; 'RE Services staff' additionally need same-business-day written pre-approval from the Business Unit Head (or, for the Business Unit Head, the General Manager, Managed Fund Services) before any trade in non-Perpetual securities, must avoid four defined non-trading periods tied to results releases, disclosing events and scheme amendments, and must hold any position for at least three months before redemption. There is no provision on margin lending, encumbrance, secured financing, hedging, short selling or stock lending, and no exemption authority beyond the ordinary pre-approval process. On its face, an RE Services staff member could obtain same-day clearance for OTC derivative legs of a collar (subject to the disclosed windows and the three-month hold), but the document gives no basis to conclude that OPH's own executives or investment managers are bound by, or protected by, any trading policy at all.
